# Game dependencies

These are the existing game's dependency versions, now served locally for reliability. Distribution headers are preserved in the files.

- Three.js r128 (`three@0.128.0`) and its matching examples: MIT. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128
- GSAP 3.12.5: the license notice in `gsap.min.js` applies. https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Original download sources were the jsDelivr Three.js package URLs and cdnjs GSAP URL already referenced in the portfolio. No new third-party runtime library was added.
